fato_historico: 1940: Benjamin O. Davis Sr. is named the first African American general in the United States Army.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a gentle wave of ambition, Pisces. Much like the historic moment when barriers were broken to welcome the first African American general, you are invited to step into your own authority. It is a good time to consider how your unique vision can lead others toward a more inclusive and compassionate future.
frase_do_dia: Believe in your strength and let your light guide the way forward.
significado_numero: Representing the structural foundation for your long-term dreams and aspirations.
conselho: Trust your intuition and confidently embrace the new leadership roles presented to you.
